Night bot: this run is on `_staging`, so it is yours, and it comes first (`priority:high`, and you take it before every other queued item): production promotes itself only from a daily run on `_staging` that passes every job, so it waits on this fix, and `_staging` holds still until this issue closes (scripts/promote-staging.sh, the freeze). You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

No GitHub access: logs unreadable; reproduce locally.

Failed jobs and their commands (super.yml):
- daily tests: `cargo test --workspace --tests --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts -- --ignored`, CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0, timeout 60 min -> "cancelled" = timed out.

- fuzz plain 7501..10000 at HEAD (game logic same as bcfdf80): ONE failure, seed 9122 (start: run), I6
  "hidden card in the view: p1 is sent "c99" at view.events[1].instanceId, a card in no pile (it ceased to
  exist) (a former id), on turn 19 (§9.1, §10.8, R97)". Repro: `/tmp/jk/jackioh fuzz --from 9122 --seeds 1`.
  Root cause TBD.
- fuzz handicap 7501..10000 and duos 1501..2000: all pass. So fuzz 4/4 = seed 9122 only (subagent root-causing).
- component 1/3: arena-corners.cy.tsx fails "R3348001 table-tavern ... desktop": `expected [] to have a length of 2 but got 0`
  (both of the viewer's props not shown: data-fit != true or visibility hidden), arena-corners.cy.tsx:74. Others in shard still running.
- arena-corners analysis: tavern is MATS[0], the spec's first mount (cold fonts/images). Failure screenshot shows both
  tavern props drawn (so fit flipped to true later via ResizeObserver/resize in useFits, CornerProps.tsx:51-86). The spec
  reads `shown(doc)` once in `cy.document().then` right after `data-fit="pending"` count is 0 -> races the re-measure.
  Fix idea: make the shown-count assertion retry (`cy.document().should(doc => expect(shown(doc)).to.have.length(2))`)
  before the one-shot obstacle checks. Verify by rerunning the spec alone.
- e2e servers: start each with run_in_background (nohup/& and curl are denied by the sandbox).
- FUZZ ROOT CAUSE (subagent, verified by it with fuzz 9122 + 9001..9300 in a scratch copy): seed 9122 step 112, p2 plays
  fused c67 `t-19:stinkyscapeplus-078+(t-1:classicplus-035+classicplus-011)`: S+#78 exiles lane 3 incl. c99 (core-096 My
  Pawn, face-down trap) and voids lane 3 (R3554002), then C+#35 Rollback restores 3 turns ago (R419). In
  crates/engine/src/subsystems/board_history.rs `rebuild_sides`: snapshot copy goes face-down -> `fresh_face_down_id`
  renames c99->c155 BEFORE placement; `place_on_field` refuses (void lane, zones.rs:708); `bounce_card` bounces it as c155
  (bounced/burned/enteredGraveyard) -> nothing ties c99 to c155; I6 (testkit/invariants.rs standing_of ~894) calls the
  earlier `exiled c99` hidden. With room in hand it is a REAL leak (p1 sees exiled id+def of a card now in p2's hand under
  another id). Fix: inside `if !landed {` before `bounce_card(sink, &card)`, restore the former id:
    if let Some(former) = &former_id { crate::state::rename_in_board_history(sink.state, &card.id, former);
      crate::generators::rename_generator(sink.state, &card.id, former); card.id = former.clone(); }

  (2) with `--expose seed=32-tribute-18` (spec 32's seed, same decks; spec 32 passes in CI) it gets further and fails at
  line 176: attack-reason text is "that unit is summoning sick" (engine combat.rs:446 since Oct), spec expects "asleep".
  Further failures after 176 unknown yet -> iterate in /tmp sandbox copy.
- component 1/3 final: only arena-corners + card-faces fail.
- SPEC 56 FIX VERIFIED (subagent, sandbox /tmp/jk-e2e, 2 green runs x 3 viewports): diff in /tmp/jk/spec56.diff, full file
  /tmp/jk/spec56-fixed.cy.ts. Four edits: seed "32-tribute-18"; text "summoning sick"; clear notice by clicking Reno's hand
  card twice (empty zone takes no click: Zone.tsx only legal picks); p1 endTurn before p2 offerDraw (R36 only active player
  offers, turn.rs:908). Import handCardId.
- NOTE: sandbox pnpm pruned root node_modules; repaired with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`.
